findings.reason: The remediation removed the intra-toolbar mix by making close nominal, but the sidecar's own tone for this key is « short verb phrase with its object, sentence case ». The fr catalogue names the close action with the infinitive in every other control (Fermer le navigateur, Fermer l’aperçu, Fermer la console, Fermer le terminal, Fermer les approbations, Fermer le fil, … — 30+ values); the only « Fermeture » in the whole 3,813-key catalogue is ui.console.close.busy, a progress status (« Fermeture… »). The lightbox is now the only close control that names the state rather than the action, and it is also the only one that contradicts its sidecar tone. Proposed: restore the infinitive on close and put next/previous in the same verb-phrase shape (« Afficher l’image suivante »), which satisfies all three sidecars and keeps the toolbar uniform. If the lane prefers the nominal set, it should record an explicit exception to the close sidecar; no width constraint applies — these are aria-label/title strings with no maxCells.
findings.disposition: new in round 2 — introduced by the FR-EXT-09 remediation; non-gating minor
